notes: Values are per 100 g of the food as described in usdaDescription.
null means the SR Legacy table has no value: it counts as 0 and the food is not listed for that nutrient.
Values are rounded to at most 4 significant digits, never otherwise changed.
Niacin is in mg NE = niacin + tryptophan*1000/60; when tryptophan is missing only niacin is used and flags.niacinNoTryptophan is true.
Composite dishes are labeled estimates: per 100 g is the sum of the ingredient per-100 g values times grams/100, on a raw-weight basis without cooking retention factors.
When an ingredient has no value for a nutrient but another ingredient does, the missing part counts as 0 and flags.partialNullNutrients lists that nutrient, so the value is a lower bound.
commonness tiers 1-5: AI model estimate (DeepSeek via hms), supervisor-reviewed
